notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
We heard your opinions about our game and we're happy to present updated release of Magician Apprentice including your observations... and even with 50% price drop for Steam Holiday Sale!

[list][*]We've given all our in-game messages and dialogs a solid proof-read, to fix all language mistakes.
[*]We've updated the interpolation algorithm on sprites, which gives much cleaner look of in-game characters
[*]We've tweaked movement algorithm, so it should be easier to travel up/down stairs
[*]We've build the game with Large Address Aware and now it should give performance boost on x86-64 machines
[*]We've optimized A-Star algorithm for character travel through different z-levels
[*]And last but not least, we've done a solid deal of optimization inside engine, including image handling functions. These should be visible on 4gb+ memory machines
[/list]

Before the end of 2015 we want to publish at least one more update which will add Workshop and Steam Cards features to the game.
